deviation_saved_login_restore.expected_by_brief: resume the saved state file and keep the existing login without logging in again
deviation_saved_login_restore.actual: After --state restoration and the first page load, only four device keys were observed (pref_app_timezone_mode=system, two navigation keys, auth_state_server_url); auth_state/todos/locale/fixed-zone keys were absent when the page became observable. No before-bootstrap storage snapshot or console log for that load was retained, so whether import omitted keys or startup later removed them is undetermined.
deviation_saved_login_restore.state_file_verified: The saved JSON contains auth_state, todos and locale/timezone keys. This verifies the file contents, not successful import before application startup; no conclusion about application deletion is made.
deviation_saved_login_restore.workaround_used: re-applied the same three prefs through the app's own keys + normal reload, then a real form login (startup-preview / fixture-only-password typed into the UI)
deviation_saved_login_restore.impact: Within the final build, real login followed by normal reload retained login, the two todos and prefs in steps 1/2/3. Step 1 therefore covers a cached saved-login reload after real login; it does not prove successful cross-build state-file restoration or native in-place installation.
